d: An investigation has been approved in a nearly 20-year-old bribery allegation involving Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The complaint relates to his tenure as Kerala’s PWD Secretary in 2006. A contractor, V.O. Sajan, alleges that Kumar demanded a ₹2 crore bribe to clear payments worth around ₹17 crore under the Kerala State Transport Project. The case also involves the death of Malaysian engineer Lee C. Bean. An earlier vigilance investigation was closed in 2012, but fresh complaints have now led to renewed scrutiny. What are the allegations, and why has the case resurfaced now?…
